fusions.name: Strutting Display
fusions.desc: Beats both wings at a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Damped] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Flung Clod
fusions.desc: Scratches up a clod of earth and hurls it for 7 damage, up to 1.8 times that at its full 7 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Cock of the Walk
fusions.desc: Your damage rises by 30% for 12 seconds, and your movement speed by 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Picking on the Weak
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
